Measure the kettle volume before and aft: Measure the kettle volume before and after a timed boil, then divide the volume lost by the boil duration in hours. For example, losing 3 L in a one-hour boil is 3 L/hour. Repeat with your usual heat level and kettle setup.

Add a measured amount of water to the tu: Add a measured amount of water to the tun, drain it as you do on brew day, and measure what remains below the outlet. Grain absorption is separate: estimate it over a brew by subtracting collected wort and tun dead space from the mash-and-sparge water used, then divide by the grain bill weight.
